description: Turns catch-all on or off for a verified custom domain. With catch-all on, mail to any address on the domain that has no alias yet creates that alias (paid plan only). With it off, such mail is dropped; existing aliases keep working either way.

enabled.description: true to turn catch-all on, false to turn it off.

name: set_custom_domain_catch_all
title: Turn catch-all on or off
